title: Source-grounded verification of the Guglielmi (2025) phenomenological earthquake theory and Tohoku-foreshock claims in OTA-SCI-0042
question: Verify the [R]/[ESTABLISHED]-marked claims in OTA-SCI-0042-2026-DE about the Guglielmi research line against the primary sources and current literature. (a) Does the arXiv preprint 'Toward a Phenomenological Theory of Earthquakes' (Guglielmi, arXiv:2510.26158v1, physics.geo-ph, Schmidt Institute of Physics of the Earth, RAS) exist as cited, is it dedicated to Boris Klain, and are the ten Appendix A discoveries accurately reported — especially #8 'modulation of global seismicity by spheroidal and toroidal oscillations of the Earth', the 'Zotov-Gesetz' as a Bath-law analog for foreshocks, the three relaxation phases (Initial → Omori → Recovery), the magnitude-dependence of the deactivation coefficient, and the anthropogenic 'weekend effect'? (b) Does the companion preprint 'Relativity of Time in Earthquake Physics' (Guglielmi & Zotov, arXiv:2509.04858) exist and does it report the 166 Tohoku foreshocks in the 200 days before the M9.1 2011 mainshock, the two eigenzeit phases (σ=0, σ=0.065), and the counter-rotating Umov-energy-flow interpretation with azimuthal splitting at 0.7°/day and 1.3°/day and maximum radial convergence 85 m/h? (c) Which of these claims are established in the broader literature versus model-dependent or as yet uncorroborated?
why_now: OTA-SCI-0042 (Feb 2026) integrates two very recent preprints (arXiv:2510.26158, arXiv:2509.04858) as the [R] foundation of the earthquake-phenomenology line, and the document's own revision register shows the Guglielmi integration (Ref. 5k–5n) is still propagating through the Omnizedenz Formelsammlung and AVI documents. The unusually specific Tohoku-foreshock figures (166 events / 200 days, 85 m/h, 0.7°/day, 1.3°/day) and the ten-discoveries list need verification against the primary sources before they anchor further archive claims; several are framed as [ESTABLISHED] while resting on preprints.
real_world_anchor: Guglielmi, A.V. (2025). 'Toward a Phenomenological Theory of Earthquakes.' arXiv:2510.26158v1 [physics.geo-ph]; Guglielmi, A.V. & Zotov, O.D. (2025). 'Relativity of Time in Earthquake Physics.' arXiv:2509.04858
novelty_reason: No prior OTA research topic covers the Guglielmi/Zotov phenomenological earthquake theory, its eigenzeit formalism, or the Tohoku-foreshock analysis; prior topics addressed Mpemba effects (OTA-SCI-0062), IRAS 07251 (OTA-SCI-0044), archaeoacoustics (OTA-OBS-0001), brain epochs (OTA-KARTE-0001), interstellar sulfur (OTA-SCI-0026), and RHIC/STAR (OTA-SCI-0037), none of which overlap with this earthquake-seismicity source document.
